He won the 2025 Masters in a playoff over Justin Rose to become the sixth to complete the career Grand Slam with Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus and Tiger Woods. He became the first European and second international player with South Africa's Gary Player to accomplish this feat. Also last year, he won the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, Players Championship and Irish Open, was a member of his eighth European Ryder Cup team and secured his seventh season-long title on the DP World Tour.
